Good to know

Is it really free?

Yes. You pay nothing and there is no obligation. You do not need to enter payment details.

What do you do with my details?

We use your website to measure and your email address to send the report. You get no newsletter and no spam. After the report we send one email to go through it, if you like.

Do I have to become a customer afterwards?

No. The report contains the first three steps. Whether you take them with us or yourself is up to you.

How long does it take?

Filling it in takes a minute. The report is in your inbox within 48 hours.
